mein qasam khata hun iss shehar ki
jabkay ( aey payghumber ! ) tum iss shehar mein muqeem ho ,
aur ( qasam khata hun ) baap ki aur uss ki aulad ki ,
kay hum ney insan ko mushaqqat mein peda kiya hai .
kiya woh yeh samajhta hai kay uss per kissi ka bus nahi chalay ga-?
kehta hai kay :  mein ney dheron maal urra daala hai .
kiya woh yeh samajhta hai kay uss ko kissi ney dekha nahi-?
kiya hum ney ussay do aankhen nahi den-?
aur aik zaban aur do hont nahi diye-?
aur hum ney uss ko dono raastay bata diye hain .
phir bhi woh uss ghaati mein dakhil nahi hosaka ,
. aur tumhen kiya pata kay woh ghaati kiya hai ?
kissi ki gardan ( ghulami say ) churra dena ,
ya phir kissi bhook walay din mein khana khila dena
kissi rishta daar yateem ko ,
ya kissi miskeen ko jo mitti mein rull raha ho ,
phir woh unn logon  mein bhi shamil naa huwa jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney aik doosray ko sabit qadmi ki takeed ki hai , aur aik doosray ko reham khaney ki takeed ki hai .
yehi woh log hain jo baray naseeb walay hain ,
aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton ka inkar kiya hai , woh nahoosat walay log hain .
unn per aesi aag musallat hogi jo unn per band kerdi jaye gi .
